description:
## Goal

A second source definition of the same qualified module must produce a module-level diagnostic and must never silently replace the first module body/interface. This includes two user-code contributions and collisions with compiler-owned runtime module names. Multiple clauses of one function inside one module remain valid.

## Current behavior / evidence

At pinned origin/main a3a9761d, `discover_modules` maps every `defmodule` to the stable `ModuleId`, then calls `index_module_body`. `ModuleMap::index_body` overwrites whatever source the slot already held.

Thus two codes defining `Foo` resolve silently, and a user `List` prevents lazy runtime `List` from loading: custom `List.count/1` runs, while unrelated `List.member?/2` disappears and only reports `resolve/unknown-import`.

## Strategy

Enforce source ownership at the module-indexing boundary, before mutating `ModuleState`; retain enough first-definition provenance for a deterministic diagnostic at the second declaration span. Add a dedicated `resolve/duplicate-module` code/message naming the qualified module.

Treat a reserved runtime-module identity as already owned, so `defmodule List` cannot bypass the check merely because runtime source is lazy. Do not extend `demand_function_scope`: by then the prior module source has already been erased.

Document the no-reopening/runtime-name rule in `.agent/docs/modules.md` and user guidance if applicable.

## Checks

- Two `submit_code` calls each defining `Foo`, even with disjoint function names, fail with `resolve/duplicate-module` at the second module declaration and keep the first source intact.
- The same test with both defining `bar/0` proves the diagnostic names module `Foo`, not duplicate function.
- A user `defmodule List` fails explicitly before the runtime List surface can disappear.
- Multiple clauses of one function within one module still compile.
- Existing duplicate-global-function and duplicate-defstruct tests stay green.
- Focused tests plus relevant compiler2 module/drive proof gates pass.
title: [BUG] Reject duplicate named-module source before it replaces the prior module body
